estimates.anchor_source: none: no market on NTTO arrivals (Polymarket/Kalshi scans, claim 13); Tourism Economics/Brand USA Sep 2026 forecast is on a different definition (42.6m vs the I-94 COR series' 34.3m) and inconsistent with -4.7% YTD (zero weight as a level anchor)
estimates.base_rate_construction: persistence class: 3Q26 = -5.75% (July -7.02 preliminary, Aug/Sep held at July's two-year stack; Sep 2025 -7.69% is the EASIEST comp of the quarter) + historical Q4-minus-Q3 mean -0.49 -> centre -6.24, sd 4.04 (n 18) -> P(<=-5) 0.62; robust MAD sd 3.6 -> 0.635; Q4-minus-July on Jul -7.0 (centre -8.0, sd 6.34) -> 0.68; revision-1 mean-reversion branch (0.50) dropped because the two-year stack already laps the Oct 2025 visa/ESTA fees (claim 8); blend 0.63
estimates.decomposition_construction: scenario mixture on the two-year stack through the -2.55% 4Q25 base (datasets/scenario_mixture_v2.csv): persist at the war-era ex-June mean -8.7 (0.45, y/y -6.3), normalise -6.5 (0.30, -4.05), deteriorate -11.0 (0.25, -8.7); within-scenario sd 3.0 -> 0.45*0.666 + 0.30*0.376 + 0.25*0.889 = 0.635, mixture centre -6.2; holding July's stack instead (persist -9.9 / normalise -7.0 / deteriorate -11.5 at 0.45/0.35/0.20) gives centre -6.8 and 0.68-0.70 (the audit's construction); single normal on the mean of the four claim-15 centres (-6.9, sd 4.2) gives 0.67; report 0.64
